text:
harry-partners: Heads up  new inbound from NimbusAI. They want to offer: Hosted API + BYOW download, but with an extra ask: custody-transfer via split-key escrow (Shamir shares) and time-limited ephemeral unwrap keys for enterprise customers. They also want a watermarking requirement on downloaded artifacts. Need legal + SI + HW input before we promise anything.

maddie-legal: Interesting. Hosted API = fine. For split-key escrow + ephemeral unwrap keys we need explicit escrow agreement language: who holds shares, release triggers, dispute process, and a liability cap. Watermarking is OK but mustn't alter the artifact integrity claim; we should require the partner to provide both watermarked and canonical signed artifact digests.

kai-solutions: From SI side we need a reproducible verification flow. If partner does Shamir shares with escrow provider, SI bundle must include: canonical artifact.tar.gz (digest), detached signature, watermark metadata (separate file), and instructions to reconstruct unwrap key via escrow release. Also require a script to verify canonical digest against marketplace-stored digest before applying any watermarks.

jorge-hw: HW note: ephemeral unwrap keys that decrypt model runtime keys inside SGX/SEV enclaves are doable. We'll need guidance on key lifetime, recommended TTLs, and re-sealing behavior if enclave restarts. Also callout: networked unseal during demo requires secure channel and nonce handling.

harry-partners: Partner proposal (high-level):

```
{
  "name":"nimbus-13b",
  "ver":"2026-05-18",
  "canonical_digest":"sha256:deadbeef...",
  "watermark":{
    "type":"parity-mark",
    "watermarked_digest":"sha256:feedface...",
    "notes":"watermark stored separately; canonical digest unchanged"
  },
  "escrow":{
    "provider":"KeySplitCo",
    "shares_held_by":["KeySplitCo","PartnerLegal"],
    "release_trigger":"addendum_signed",
    "shamir_threshold":2
  },
  "ephemeral_unwrap":{
    "ttl_seconds":3600,
    "kms_ref":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/abcd"
  }
}
```

kai-solutions: Good example. We should require partner to also publish a reconstruction proof (signed statement showing share IDs and timestamps) and an example recovery run. SI will add a pre-download check: verify canonical_digest matches our stored digest, then if download is watermarked, attach watermark metadata but don't change canonical bits.

maddie-legal: Contractually: 1) add escrow acceptance criteria (provider vetting), 2) define release triggers (addendum_signed OR court_order), 3) require partner to provide signed reconstruction_proof and retain share audit logs for 24 months, 4) explicit warranty that watermarking does not alter canonical artifact and that canonical digest verifies. Also cap liability and require indemnity for provenance defects.

jorge-hw: For ephemeral unwrap keys used in enclaves, recommend default TTL 1 hour, shorter for demos. Document re-seal steps: when enclave restarts it must request a new ephemeral unwrap token; partner must support programmatic rewrap. We'll add a small integration test for this.

harry-partners: Marketplace ops question: can we show "Available: Hosted API" and a gated "BYOW with escrow" card that requires signed addendum + escrow proof before download? Partner wants sales outreach to begin only after escrow acceptance.

marketplace-bot: created ticket PARTNERS-5601 to track Nimbus split-key escrow flow, watermarking, and ephemeral-unlock integration  https://redwood.company/issue/PARTNERS-5601

kai-solutions: Ops suggestion: two-track launch: Track 1 (Hosted API) Day 0; Track 2 (BYOW + escrow) shows as "request access" until escrow + addendum + reconstruction proof are provided. That prevents accidental distribution. We'll prepare SI bundle template and a verification script stub (sha256 check + gpg verify + reconstruction-proof verify).

maddie-legal: I'll draft an addendum template with escrow language, share-holding rules, release triggers, retention periods, watermarking warranty, and indemnity items. Draft by Mon COB.

harry-partners: Action items recap: Maddie drafts addendum, Kai produces SI bundle + verification snippets, Jorge drafts enclave unwrap/TTL guidance and a small integration test, partner to confirm escrow provider and provide a sample reconstruction_proof. We'll reconvene after items land. Thanks.
